summary: Per-vehicle per-frame update (thiscall on the vehicle struct). Resets the vehicle substate at this+4109, dispatches the render/session guard sub_4D1180 into two 12-byte scratch buffers, then, when the a2 flag is set or the substate check sub_4BC9B0 fails, tracks the AI path position, updates suspension state, issues a conditional buffer call keyed on the sub_4D1180 result, and either clears or advances the vehicle state machine at this+3251; on the advance path it dispatches the game state branch when this vehicle's +0x4894 slot matches the current vehicle's +0x4894 value. Finally initializes camera viewport/frustum and, for session type 7 with race phase 3 or 4, returns a vehicle climb adjust result.

local_names.v4: result of sub_4D1180 (char) selecting the state path
local_names.v5: zero-flag of v4 passed as the ConditionalBufferCall argument

operations.description: Reset the vehicle substate at this + 4109 via sub_4BB8E0 before the update block.
Dispatch sub_4D1180(this, v9, v8); its char result v4 selects the state path below.
If a2 is non-zero OR sub_4BC9B0(v3, 0, 0) returns 0 (substate not active/ready), run the path/suspension/state block.
Track the AI vehicle path position from the v9/v8 buffers via AIVehiclePathPositionTracking.
Update suspension physics state for the this + 3 substruct via SuspensionStateUpdate.
Set v5 = (v4 == 0) and call ConditionalBufferCall(v5), a conditional buffer flush keyed on whether the sub_4D1180 result was zero.
If v4 (sub_4D1180 result) is non-zero clear the object state, otherwise advance the state machine on the this + 3251 substruct.
When v4 is non-zero, clear the vehicle object state via ObjectStateClear(this + 3251).
When v4 is zero, advance the vehicle state machine via StatePhaseSetter(this + 3251).
If this[4645] (field +0x4894) equals the value read at *(dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54E4] + 18580) (the current vehicle's +0x4894 slot), dispatch the game state branch.
Branch the game state to the next phase via GameStateBranchDispatch(&dword_5EA510) when the +0x4894 compare matches.
Initialize the camera viewport/frustum for this vehicle via CameraViewportFrustumInitialization(this); the result is the default return value.
If session type dword_7C56A4 == 7 and race phase dword_7C56A8 is 3 or 4, return VehicleClimbAdjust(1) instead of the camera result.
Adjust the vehicle climb/height via VehicleClimbAdjust(1) on the race-phase 3/4 branch.
Return the CameraViewportFrustumInitialization result, or the VehicleClimbAdjust result when the dword_7C56A8 == 3/4 branch fired.
Called by sub_42D140 (0x0042D140) and SceneRenderUpdate (0x004C6D90) as part of the per-frame vehicle update path.
